rationale: AD-344 and epic #880. The module archkeel.analyzer.pin joins the analyzer component and resolves and checks the file of a pinned collector. ProducerKind is an enum of archkeel.ir.facts that archkeel.check.ports re-exports and the check component publishes, so the CLI names who started the collector. The coupling budget of cli to check gains that one name. Two line-bound type-ignore exemptions of process.py follow their moved lines. No requires entry, Any permission or through selector changes.
